summary.text: Julie Palakovich Carr is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 17 who has served since January 9, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Palakovich Carr earned a B.A. in biology from Boston University in 2005 and an M.S. in biology from the University of Minnesota in 2007.

Her professional experience includes serving as a legislative fellow for U.S. Senator Maria Cantwell, public policy manager at the American Institute of Biological Sciences, and a member of the Rockville City Council.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Audit and Evaluation Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
